name: Puma Steel
old_description: With decades of experience throughout the Western U.S., Puma Steel provides exceptional fabrication, project management, BIM modeling, engineering services, in-house detailing, design build, and design assist services for structural steel in Colorado, Wyoming, and across the West. At Puma, you will find a dependable partner for your projects, and consistently outstanding service from our engineers, project managers, and quality specialists. Through use of the most advanced equipment and new technologies, we have become the premier provider of structural steel for Colorado, Wyoming, and anywhere our customers need a valued team member.
about:
Based in Cheyenne, Wyoming, Puma Steel has operated for decades across the Western United States as a structural steel fabricator and supplier. The company serves Colorado, Wyoming, and surrounding states from its Cheyenne yards, where it maintains thousands of tons of steel inventory.

Puma Steel provides a full range of steel services including structural and miscellaneous steel fabrication, design-build, design-assist, steel supply, pre-processing, project management, in-house BIM modeling, engineering, detailing, value engineering, erection, and LEED documentation. The firm dedicates in-house engineers, project managers, and quality specialists to each project, and its fabrication capacity is supported by large yard stock.

The company works primarily with general contractors on commercial, healthcare, education, and government projects. Notable examples include the 1144 Fifteenth office tower in Denver (GC Hensel Phelps), the Utah Data Center at Camp Williams, the Marian H. Rochelle Gateway Center at the University of Wyoming (GC Haselden Construction), and medical centers such as Platte Valley Medical Center and Lutheran Medical Center.

Puma Steel emphasizes communication, professionalism, and safety as differentiators. It holds AISC certification as a fabricator since 1997, maintains AWS-certified welding inspectors, and operates an award-winning safety program. The firm also offers non-destructive testing (NDT Level I and II) including liquid penetrant, magnetic particle, and ultrasonic inspection, along with sophisticated paint coating endorsements (P1, P2, P3).
